_doc: Canon ROLE map — the automation that ends stale-role reads. CURATED (a human declares canon), MACHINE-ENFORCED by canon-guard.py. Distinct from resolve-canon.py: that resolves a NAME across the four lanes by md5 (the Warriors rule); THIS resolves a ROLE across DIFFERENT names inside the repo. Canon is what is WIRED, never 'the highest version number' and never what a README/handoff/prose claims.
_correction_2026-07-26: The Studio Eyes role was first declared BACKWARDS here (canonical=studio-eyes/studio-eyes.py, sweep 'superseded'), inferred from the SESSION-2026-07-26 handoff + the v3 README. VERIFICATION inverted it: version headers + wiring show studio-eyes-sweep.py is v4 RENDER-PROOF and wired into ratchet.py + safe-push.sh + floor.yml, while studio-eyes/studio-eyes.py is v3 and UNWIRED. The lesson this manifest exists to enforce nearly got enforced backwards. Canon = wired + versioned, established by check, never by prose.
how_to_use: canon-guard.py --self-test (gate the guard) ; canon-guard.py --refs (scan repo code/workflows for references to declared-superseded files; HALT) ; canon-guard.py --check <file>.

v3, real Chromium via Playwright: EXECUTES JS, flips comfort stops via document.body.className and re-reads getComputedStyle, screenshots pixels under glyphs. The JS/dynamic-state capability v4 (no JS) cannot have. Kept per the v3 review 2026-07-26 (do not retire).

Needs the playwright pkg + a matching Chromium at runtime (CI's `playwright install` provides it; a bare sandbox does not, so its self-test could not be executed this session — the '20/20' is per its docstring, unverified here).

roles.status: canonical = v4 (supersedes v3.1 + the contrast gate). RULED 2026-07-27: preship-contrast-gate.py (v2) is a REGEX CSS parser — the guess-the-cascade approach v3/v4 explicitly replaced (every historical bug traced to it) — and it emits emoji, violating the no-emoji floor. Its token-contrast logic is a strict subset of the render-proof v4. Retired. Its only reference lives in archived rescued/ code (not live), so --refs stays clean (archive dirs are excluded from the scan). NOTE: no 'preship-gate-v2.py' exists — the handoff's 'v2 referenced by 11 files' is false in this repo.

_gates_doc: GATE PROMOTION LEDGER. A report-mode gate ('spins but does not drive') promotes to blocking ONLY when BOTH hold: (a) OBJECTIVE readiness — green on its blocking_scope, evidence recorded; and (b) FOUNDER GO — founder_go:true with confidence >= 0.70. canon-guard --gates enforces the COUPLING: a gate declared 'blocking' here must be wired in floor.yml as a non-continue-on-error `--strict` step over its blocking_scope (approval without enforcement HALTs, and enforcement without approval HALTs). This is the ratchet: a gate blocks where green and reports where not.

repo is canon over shelf (resolve-canon precedence); guard should HALT any tool reading the shelf copy as current.
v5 = three-broadcast canon (ratified 2026-07-26); v6 parked; slices are sources.

principles: canon = what is WIRED + versioned, established by check; never inferred from a README, a handoff, or prose (that inference put the Studio Eyes role in backwards on the first pass).
repo > shelf: if a shelf copy differs from repo, the shelf is stale.

a role's canon is DECLARED here once; it is ENFORCED ONLY when canon-guard --refs/--wiring run in CI. THAT WIRING DOES NOT YET EXIST (workflow-scope paste, founder). Until it does, this manifest is ADVISORY and CAN rot — do not claim it 'cannot rot' (red-team #1, 2026-07-26).
do not mark a sibling superseded until the founder rules — an unratified supersession enforced in CI is worse than none.
